description: This file defines the SecondMoment class, a statistical calculator for the second central moment, extending the FirstMoment class. It provides methods to increment data points, clear the data, copy instances, and retrieve the computed second moment value.

classes.name: SecondMoment
classes.description: A class to compute the second central moment of a dataset, extending FirstMoment with additional logic for the second moment calculations.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Adds a new data point and updates the second moment calculation based on recursive formulas.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the calculation state, clearing all previously added data.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the current value of the second moment, or NaN if no data has been added.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a SecondMoment instance.
